caption_en: **Accuracy–efficiency Pareto frontier.** x = parameter count (log scale), y = 4-horizon mean 7-variable z-space MSE; the step line is the Pareto set {NLinear, 2,520 parameters; PatchTST, 531,878 parameters}. PatchTST spends 211× the parameters of NLinear for 11.2 % lower MSE; the fitted slope of MSE against log₁₀(parameters) is +0.1171 with R² = 0.0223, i.e. size explains ~2 % of the variance and the sign is positive. Windows: shared (W//16)*16 = 160/144/144/128; seeds 42/43/44. Reproduced by `05_程序代码/plot_pareto.py`. Hardware: A100-SXM4-80GB | partition stingy | CityU HPC Burgundy.
caption_zh: **精度—效率帕累托前沿。** x 为参数量（对数轴），y 为 4 个跨度的 7 变量 z 空间 MSE 均值；阶梯线为帕累托集合 {NLinear 2,520 参数；PatchTST 531,878 参数}。PatchTST 用 211 倍参数量换取 11.2% 的 MSE 下降；MSE 对 log₁₀(参数量) 的拟合斜率为 +0.1171，R² = 0.0223，即规模只能解释约 2% 的方差且符号为正。窗口为共享的 (W//16)*16 = 160/144/144/128；种子 42/43/44。由 `05_程序代码/plot_pareto.py` 生成。硬件：A100-SXM4-80GB，stingy 分区，CityU HPC Burgundy。
